featured_reviews.name: prashant makhija
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I came to Mumbai and it reminded me of this hospital. In 2024 I admitted my sister here but forgot to write the review. So here it is.

It was early morning and my sister had sudden pain in her stomach. Looking at the pain I was quite evident that it was due to stone. As we were near to Parakh hospital we reached there. As per doctor's advice ultrasound was done and as I thought it was due to stone only. We requested doctor to provide some medicine for getting relief from pain so that we can go back to Gwalior and we will take further treatment there as it is our hometown. But he insisted for getting admitted. Considering the pain we decided for getting admitted. They kept giving my sister injections and medicines for holding the pain. Also ran some other tests. After 24 hours they started insisting for surgery. We finally decided to get discharged from the hospital. The total expense that we had to pay for this 1 day was 30000/-
Worse part was that immediately after the discharge the pain returned and my sister was still in the same situation as 1 day before.
At last I went to a medical store nearby and told him about the pain. The medical store guy gave just 1 pill and with that medicine the entire pain vanished and my sister reached back Gwalior via train without any pain.
In Gwalior she took homeopathy medicine treatment and in six months all the stones are gone without any surgery.

So I'm not sure about how this hospital is at present but in October 2024 they literally looted us in just a single day. So beware.

I would advise others to inquire about consultation fees in advance to avoid unpleasant surprises.

featured_reviews.name: ShriGanpati Enterprises
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was hospitalized recently and overall my experience was mixed. I sincerely appreciate the ward boys and support staff (mausi staff) for being kind, supportive and attentive throughout my stay. Their behaviour made a difficult time easier.
However, I was disappointed with the nursing staff. As patients are already physically and emotionally vulnerable, polite communication, empathy and timely support are extremely important. Unfortunately, my experience with the nursing team did not meet these expectations.
I am sharing this feedback not to criticize anyone personally, but with the hope that the hospital management takes this seriously and improves patient care and staff behaviour so that future patients have a better experience.

featured_reviews.name: Tauheed Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Medical treatment and doctors wise, Nulife Multispeciality Hospital is very good and reliable. However, their appointment and token management system needs a serious upgrade.

​Even after booking an appointment from home and getting a specific time slot, patients are asked to wait for a long time at the reception. The staff doesn't disclose the queue number or tell us how many patients are ahead of us.

​While the medical care is excellent, the reception team needs to be more transparent about the waiting time so patients don't have to wait blindly. Hoping the management looks into this operational issue.

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very good experience at this multi-specialty hospital. The facilities are clean and well-maintained, and the staff is professional, caring, and supportive. The nursing and support staff are also attentive and helpful throughout the stay. The hospital provides a wide range of services under one roof, which makes it very convenient. featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Care & Trustworthy Expertise—A Deeply Appreciated Recovery Experience of Rohit Vinerkar

My recent admission to Zynova Shalby Hospital for Typhoid Fever (Nov 13-17) reaffirmed the trust my family and I place in this institution, particularly after my mother’s successful knee replacement in 2022.

I approached Dr. Satvik Patel for a second opinion on November 12th. I was thoroughly impressed with his approach; he carefully assessed my situation and ordered the necessary tests. The following day, with the diagnosis confirmed, Dr. Patel advised an SOS admission.

Dr. Patel's Professional Excellence and New Discoveries -
During my treatment for typhoid, another concern related to my health came forward. Dr. Patel immediately took charge, providing guidance and treatment in a cool and composed manner. He is truly the MS Dhoni of medicine, maintaining his calm demeanor and delivering effective treatment under pressure. This ability to manage complex situations without stress was immensely reassuring.
Furthermore, his thoroughness brought to light a fascinating personal detail: I apparently have an abundance of RBCs in my blood. Dr. Patel, not only provided treatment for the fever but also gave me some great life advice—I've been kindly recommended to donate blood often. (It seems I now generate content both for the screen and for the blood bank. Who knew my body was producing a surplus!)
His ability to explain all these complex findings clearly in excellent Marathi instantly built a strong and enduring connection. It was incredibly reassuring to hear detailed medical advice given with such clarity and ease. "तुमचा स्वभाव आणि समजावण्याची पद्धत, सर, अगदी कौतुकास्पद आहे."
We are now hoping to resolve this new challenge soon under his expert care.

Staff, Facilities, and Comfort -
The medical attention and human touch provided by the staff were consistently excellent. The nurses were attentive and meticulous in my care.
Even while recovering in Room 605 (a choice made for the Vastu and morning sunlight), I felt well-supported and comfortable. The colour choice of the interior is lively, and the view from the window is amazing, contributing greatly to the positive atmosphere. I even watched the India vs. South Africa cricket test!

On November 14th, the staff's care gave me enough comfort to watch the broadcast of Doraemon Movie Earth Symphony on Disney India. As I was the Assistant Dubbing Director and Mixing Engineer for that project, it was a unique and meaningful experience to connect with my work while recovering. The quality and timing of the food service were also good.

A Critical Point for Management Consideration -
While the patient care is truly awesome, I must address a severe pain point that impacts accessibility for many patients: The security deposit requested during the admission process is significantly higher than usual.
It is challenging for patients, especially those with high-premium insurance coverage, to submit such a substantial deposit. If Zynova Shalby’s core mission is to serve humanity, I strongly urge the management to reassess this security deposit policy. Streamlining this financial aspect would remove a severe point of friction and ensure that exceptional medical care is accessible to all.

Overall: I am grateful for the expert medical treatment and compassionate attention I received. Thank you, Zynova, and especially Dr. Patel, for taking excellent care of me. "हम दिल से आपके आभारी हैं। एक मरीज को और क्या चाहिए? सब कुछ बहुत अच्छा था।" I am focusing on a swift recovery and look forward to being fit soon!

First of all, we registered the name with a trust of Dr. Mrs. and Mr. Mathkar, but they were not available for the delivery, though it was a little premature delivery, still two days before Dr. was available and could not notice the delivery can happen very soon, and went unavailable.
